story: Jordan, uninsured, fell off a bike and broke a wrist (non-displaced distal radius fracture), seen in Ronald Reagan UCLA's emergency department (real UCLA prices): X-rays before and after the splint, an IV push for pain. Single, Westwood resident, about 240% of the poverty line. No billing errors: UCLA's own policy gives uninsured patients at or below 400% FPL 100% charity care, so the bill goes to $0.

tiers.quote: Self-Pay Patients with Patient's Family incomes not exceeding 400% of the FPL and who reside in the Hospital's primary service area as defined in Appendix 1 may be eligible for a 100% Charity Care discount on services rendered and billed by the Hospital for emergency and Medically Necessary Care.

app_notes: Uninsured: case.json has "eob": {}. finance.reconcile here was given a self-pay pseudo-EOB whose patient_responsibility is the corrected charges. The app's Nessie agent (agents/auditor.py) reads eob['patient_responsibility'] directly, so it cannot run this case until it handles a missing EOB.
Not modeled: California caps charges for uninsured patients at or under 400% FPL at the greater of Medicare or Medi-Cal (HSC 127405(d)); a real audit could argue more off.
